stories.title: Ontario tables new law introducing stronger legal protections for victims of intimate image abuse
stories.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford's government tabled a bill Monday that would create a new legal pathway for victims of intimate image abuse to have those images deleted.

details.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford's government tabled a bill Monday that would create a new legal pathway for victims of intimate image abuse to have those images deleted.

stories.title: Several staffers leaving Poilievre's office weeks after B.C. election
stories.summary: OTTAWA - Five staff members are leaving the office of Opposition Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre, including his deputy chief of staff and two of his senior communications aides.

Five members of the Opposition leader's office have informed Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre they plan to quit. The departures will leave big gaps in Poilievre's office, particularly in communications and policy.

stories.title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
stories.summary: Russia said Ukraine had launched over 2,000 drones over the course of a day, while Kyiv came under a record 17 air raid alerts.
stories.detail: Russian air defences intercepted 1,336 drones launched by Ukraine, Russia's Defence Ministry said Monday, in what appeared to be Kyiv's biggest aerial attack since Moscow's all-out invasion of its neighbour nearly five years ago.
